categories.name: Android companion · Daily use
categories.tagline: A tablet that is useful without asking for attention.

categories.name: Android companion · Nearby and offline
categories.tagline: Optional play that helps more than it drains.

ideas.title: A proper tablet touch layout
ideas.pitch: Let Chat and the Lua apps breathe on a larger screen.
ideas.experience: A child can see the latest reply, one clear next action and the game without crowded controls.
ideas.how: Keep decisions in shared Lua; rebuild only the Android canvas and navigation in Kotlin.
ideas.risks: Test small phones, large tablets and accessibility text sizes.

ideas.title: A lighter offline reading voice
ideas.pitch: Keep spoken drafts and loaded replies useful on old tablets.
ideas.experience: A short reply speaks offline without a long wait or hot battery.
ideas.how: Measure the embedded model, add a smaller verified voice option and cap synthesis work.
ideas.risks: A smaller voice may sound less natural; audio and battery need device measurements.

ideas.title: Quiet reply notifications
ideas.pitch: Show a reply when the tablet is awake, with family privacy.
ideas.experience: A notification says Levi replied without exposing the conversation on the lock screen.
ideas.how: Use opt-in Android notification channels and authenticated foreground-safe polling or push.
ideas.risks: Background power and private text on shared tablets must be controlled.
ideas.audience: Families using the tablet between activities

ideas.title: Optional nearby board games
ideas.pitch: Pair with a watch or Deck only for a chosen local app session.
ideas.experience: A nearby game works without Wi-Fi, then the Bluetooth link goes quiet.
ideas.how: Add a separate physically confirmed tablet peer slot and bounded foreground GATT transport.
ideas.risks: Current board bonding is single-peer; firmware enrollment and battery tests come first.
ideas.audience: Families playing with watch, Deck and tablet

ideas.title: Old-device performance mode
ideas.pitch: Keep the companion responsive on Android 6 class hardware.
ideas.experience: Chat, Trail and Notes launch quickly even when voice features are never used.
ideas.how: Lazy-load native voice runtimes, cap memory and measure cold start on API 23 hardware.
ideas.risks: Old TLS trust stores and low RAM may limit connected or voice features.
ideas.audience: Owners of older phones and tablets
